subtopic: Investment Advisory Agreements and Terms of Service
source_evidence: This agreement is a legal document – so it is very important to read your investment advisory agreement before you “sign” it by clicking the box.
question: Misconception: If an advisory agreement appears as an “I agree” checkbox, it is just a routine click and there is no need to read it or the app’s Terms of Service.
answer: Correction: The advisory agreement is a legal document that describes services and fees, so read it before agreeing. Also read any Terms of Service or similar agreements, because some of their terms might be incorporated into the advisory agreement, or vice versa.
